close_match.limit: one period layout; no comparative, quarterly, by-customer, by-tag or % of income variants
one layout with retained-earnings roll-forward; no comparative, summary or detail variants
one account at a time; TX_DET_BY_ACCT is not reproduced

boundary: A native report is original NXT output computed from this book. It is not a QuickBooks report, not a parity claim, and not an official government form.
no_native_equivalent: All remaining report tokens, including every payroll report route, the inventory reports, the customer/vendor contact and phone lists, T4A and T5018, cash-flow detail, unbilled charges and time, and the custom/memorised report paths.
